comment: Couldn't justify it for three vans.
When a tech was off, reassigning his jobs double-booked people. Happened weekly.
Moved to a tool that handles reassignment properly.
Double bookings when we moved jobs between engineers. Customers turned up to no one.
Dispatchers found re-planning a day after a sick call took ages and kept clashing.
Price went up and we're tiny.
Our office manager left and nobody else learned it.
Reassigning jobs created overlaps the system didn't warn about.
